description:
Mark one notification as read

Marks a single notification as read and stamps its `readAt` with the current server time. Ownership is verified first: a notification belonging to another account answers 404 exactly as an unknown id does, so the endpoint never reveals that a foreign id exists. Calling it again on an already read notification succeeds and refreshes `readAt`. This endpoint takes no request body. It answers with a short confirmation message rather than the updated notification.

id.description: Identifier of the notification to mark as read. Must be an integer; a non-numeric value answers 400.

name: mark_notification_read
title: Mark one notification as read
